patterns.key_values: dark graphite agenda pane (two-tone vs light content), ~256pt-class; top: '+' create + 'September YYYY' (year in brand red) + month chevrons; compact mini-month calendar (today = blue circle, multi-colour event dots under dates); scrolling agenda list grouped by UPPERCASE relative-date headers

agenda row = identity-colour dot (or open task circle) + time range (secondary ~10-11pt) + title (primary 13pt) + optional location (tertiary); filled tag pills + inline blue 'Join' CTA where relevant; events and tasks interleaved in one list

content-top row: leading 'Today' capsule + chevrons; centred Day/Week/Month/Quarter/Year capsule segmented control ('Week' active, subtle capsule fill); monochrome, single '+' primary lives in sidebar

week grid: 7 day columns (weekday cap + date numeral; today cap red, today numeral in blue circle, today column washed pale-blue); 'all day' band of muted event pills; hour-ruled body with gutter labels; pastel event blocks; red now-line with leading dot

signature_moves: Brand-red as typographic jewelry — the YEAR ('September 2025'), today weekday label, 'TODAY' header, and the now-line carry Fantastical red while structure stays neutral; system blue keeps the selection/today role, so red is spent only on identity + time-indicator (disciplined accent budget)

Two-tone window — dark graphite agenda pane against a light calendar canvas separates 'what's next' (list) from 'when' (grid) by luminance alone; unusual for AppKit where the source list normally lightens the window
The agenda/DayTicker pane REPLACES the conventional list-of-calendars source-list — the sidebar shows your day (mini-month + relative-date-grouped events + tasks), not your data sources
Today over-signaled on purpose — blue date circle + red weekday cap + pale-blue column wash + red now-line converge; redundancy that would be noise elsewhere is legibility in a dense grid
Inline contextual affordances — blue 'Join' pill on video events, tickable circle on tasks put the next action in the row (natural-language-parsing lineage surfacing as one-tap follow-through)
defects: Contrast Dilution (non-text, #10) — hour/day hairline rules and pastel event fills likely <3:1 on white; legibility rides on dark title text over the tint rather than fill/border (calendar convention, near the WCAG 3:1 floor; unverified from composite)
Uppercase agenda group headers (native-tell #4, soft) — 'TODAY'/'TOMORROW' tracked uppercase; mitigated by relative-date convention (date-group headers, not source-list section headers)
Target Starvation (#11) — mini-calendar day cells ~14-16px, below the 24px WCAG pointer floor (common in date pickers)
Secondary time/location text (~50-55% white) on the dark sidebar reads near the 4.5:1 floor (watch, unverified from composite)

aesthetic.direction: Native-utilitarian pro-productivity — the system SF Pro ramp and Apple-Calendar week-grid convention, run at high density, with one committed brand-red accent as jewelry and a two-tone dark/light luminance split; neo-grotesque-product family expressed through genuine AppKit chrome rather than a bespoke web look
aesthetic.cluster_hint: native-pro-agenda (dense native productivity tools with one committed brand accent)

psychology: Jakob's Law — inherits Apple Calendar's week grid, red now-line, and Day/Week/Month scope segmented control, so users transfer expectations at zero learning cost; innovation is reserved for the agenda pane
Von Restorff effect / signal-detection — the today column and red now-line are the one saturated break in a neutral grid; the single thing you need (now) is the single thing that pops
Hick's Law (browse exception) — a full week + interleaved agenda is high option density, correct for an expert SCAN surface (not a decision point); density is a feature, not overload
Gestalt proximity / common region — each event is one chunk (dot + time + title + location); tag pills use enclosure as common region; between-group agenda gaps exceed within-row gaps
Serial-position / F-pattern — agenda reads top-down TODAY -> TOMORROW; prime top-left of the window holds the month title and today
Aesthetic-Usability Effect — consistent pastel tints, capsule controls, and disciplined red accent buy first-contact trust for a data-dense scheduling tool
notes: Evidence is a MARKETING COMPOSITE ONLY — a 1200x628 cover with the app icon, the 'Fantastical' wordmark ('cal' knocked out of a red block = brand red confirmed), and three devices on a pink-to-lilac gradient. The Mac window occupies only ~430px of width behind an overlapping iPad, so EVERY value is (estimated) with wide ranges and low confidence; colours are compression-affected. Only ONE Mac surface exists (Week view). The iPad (dark sidebar + light grid, 'My Calendar Set') and iPhone (fully dark agenda) are iPadOS/iOS — recorded as context, NOT digested, excluded from macOS canon. No settings, no dialog, no empty state, no full dark-mode Mac window seen. The two-tone dark-sidebar/light-content split is distinctive but MAY be an appearance/theme setting rather than the sole default — recorded as observed, flagged. Lineage is native with HIGH confidence (real traffic lights + real menu bar with status items + 13pt density + capsule macOS-26 segmented control + no iOS tells), but era liquid-glass is only med — capsule control SHAPES are present yet glass lensing is not confirmable from this render (insufficient-evidence); no glass-in-content violation regardless (week grid fully opaque). Task was Workflow A (UI) ONLY; icon.webp (the calendar squircle with red top bar + coloured tiles) was NOT digested as an icon. A real @2x Mac screenshot would confirm tokens, settle the theme question, and unlock absolute pt.
